title: Tighten workspace recovery warning timing and identity assertions
outcome: The fake-clock workspace recovery tests distinguish the intended warning from unrelated console warnings and catch a warning emitted before 10 seconds.
acceptance: The recovery warning tests assert no warning through 9,999 ms and the intended recovery warning after the final millisecond, without real waits.
Slow-server and slow-session-metadata success and the deadline-abort case continue to assert one non-aborting warning and existing cleanup and late-result fencing behavior.
